name.value: Tata AIA Life Insurance Waiver of Premium Plus (Linked) Rider

uin.note: The rider page publishes V03. ULIP product pages name V02 and V03 or later. V02 documents were not found.

linked_or_non_linked.value: linked rider, individual health insurance rider; charge cancelled from units

attached_to_ulips.note: Not available with the Future Secure and Family Secure plan options of i Systematic.

waiver_of_premium.value: If the proposer (who is different from the life assured) dies or becomes totally and permanently disabled by accident or sickness, all future premiums of the basic plan are waived and the rider charge stops, for the rest of the premium paying term or until the proposer reaches 70.
waiver_of_premium.quote: Then we will waive all the future premiums of the basic plan
waiver_of_premium.note: Unambiguous: "basic plan". Premium payer is the proposer, not the life assured.

waiver_on_death_of_life_assured.value: not covered (events are those of the proposer)
waiver_on_death_of_life_assured.quote: An exclusive rider designed for the Proposer of the base plan
waiver_on_death_of_life_assured.note: The rider is a premium waiver for the proposer only.

waiver_on_death_or_illness_of_proposer.value: Death of the proposer, or total and permanent disability of the proposer (12 months continuous), waives the base plan premiums. No critical illness trigger.

critical_illness.quote: An exclusive rider designed for the Proposer of the base plan
critical_illness.note: The rider is a premium waiver for the proposer only.

accidental_death.quote: An exclusive rider designed for the Proposer of the base plan
accidental_death.note: The rider is a premium waiver for the proposer only.

accidental_disability.value: No payout. Disability of the proposer only triggers the waiver.
accidental_disability.quote: An exclusive rider designed for the Proposer of the base plan
accidental_disability.note: The rider is a premium waiver for the proposer only.

rider_term.value: Minimum 5 years. Maximum: until the end of the base plan premium payment term or proposer age 70, whichever is earlier.
rider_term.quote: Till premium payment term of the

premium_paying_rules.value: Rider charge deducted for the maximum rider coverage term. Rider term equals the base plan premium payment term.
premium_paying_rules.quote: with rider coverage term equal to the premium paying term

sum_assured_limits.value: Sum of all future premiums of the basic plan to be waived.
sum_assured_limits.quote: Sum of all the future premiums

premium_deduction.value: Charge recovered monthly by cancellation of units from the unit fund of the base policy.
premium_deduction.quote: The charge for the rider will be recovered monthly by cancellation
